dct_title_s: Butler County, Iowa, 1952, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BZG. Form of individual image numbering: BZG-1K-[number], BZG-2K-[number], or BZG-3K-[number]. Date of publication inferred from dates on individual photographs within the mosaic. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
